in_marathi.name: Devacharan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devacharan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Devacharan' is derived from Sanskrit language. It is a compound of two words: 'Deva' meaning 'God' and 'Chara' meaning 'Journey'. Hence, the name Devacharan signifies the journey of God.
